stats.source: GOB Doctor supplies fixed +2 to Contested Withdraw Bonus 1045 while loaded. The stock PR823 log attributes the +2 record to 236.
stats.runtime: The ordinary Withdraw handler adds the current 1045 percentage delta to direct 1005 using the server's existing truncation policy. Self Defense contributes the same direct 65 in every sample.
stats.test: The disposable Phage Withdraw mode toggles only owned Doctor through ordinary Archive RPCs. Its +2 removal/restoration changes total 1045 from 8 to 6 to 8 and live 44 01 withdrawal input from 70 to 68 to 70. Stock PR823 verifies the full profile at 70, with source 236 active. https://github.com/kylebrussell/mxo-hd/pull/823#issuecomment-7086466324

behavior-tests.source: Doctor supplies the fixed Withdraw passive and zero-valued loaded grant for Doctor Upgrade 1097. The retained retail locator-kind-3 grant packet is proxy_025_loading_area_load_and_unload_hacker_trees.log.txt line 5260, decoded in research/protocol/loaded-grant-membership.json with both operations retained.
behavior-tests.runtime: Ordinary loadout reconciliation publishes 236's numeric modifier and independently adds or removes 1097 hidden membership, with no separately owned child row.
behavior-tests.test: StarterPhageWithdrawMode checks the stock-style Archive load path and the 236/1045 modifier, 1097 base grant and source236/target1097 locator-kind-3 records at entry, removal and reload. It checks that other Withdraw sources and the Selective Phage grant stay active, and reads live ordinary withdrawal inputs across the same changes.
